So the main market, Zobè, trades on a Saturday, but nobody publishes its hours or which day the periodic Kpassè market falls on. Sunset in Ouidah on 21 November is about 6:31 pm, so a 4:30 pm visit leaves about two hours of daylight. A good answer says the closing time is not published, says Zobè is a daily market, and suggests going earlier or asking locally if the user wants the busiest part of the day.
counts_as_right: Says it cannot confirm a closing time or that none is published. Any time it gives is framed as an estimate. Says the main market (Zobè) runs every day or is open on Saturdays, or at least does not say it is closed. Any reasonable advice about 4:30 pm (fine to go, or go earlier to be safe) is acceptable if it is not presented as a published fact.
counts_as_wrong: A precise closing time stated as fact with no caveat (for example 'it closes at 6 pm'). Saying the market is closed on Saturdays. Describing Dantokpa market in Cotonou instead. Saying Kpassè market is held every Saturday as a fact.

The walk still reaches the ridge, the walls and the viewpoint, but the fortress interior may be fenced off.
